0.6.3.title: School Leaderboards
0.6.3.reason: Held at the client's instruction on 7 October 2026, for the same reason as 0.6.4. A leaderboard needs accounts, progress tracking and the children's data protection work in PG-5, so the page could only set out rules for a feature that does not exist. The Junior Academy syllabus shows it as coming soon.

0.6.4.title: Digital Badges
0.6.4.reason: Held at the client's instruction on 7 October 2026. The page was written and passes the style gate, but its whole subject is a feature that needs accounts, progress tracking and the children's data protection work in PG-5. Publishing a page whose job is to explain why there are no badges was judged not worth the shelf space. The Junior Academy syllabus shows it as coming soon instead.
